title: wolfssl_ec_key.h: static inline function bodies in shared header
description: wolfssl_ec_key.h defines wolfssl_ec_ctx, wolfssl_ec_xlat_err, wolfssl_ec_key_import, wolfssl_ec_key_generate, wolfssl_ec_key_export_public, wolfssl_ec_key_export_private, and wolfssl_ec_key_free as static or static inline. Both wolfssl_ecdh.c and wolfssl_ecdsa.c include it, producing duplicate copies in each TU. Any third consumer (e.g. ml-dsa, x25519) adds another copy. Text bloat aside, wolfssl_ec_xlat_err logs pr_err_ratelimited — each TU has its own rate-limit bucket, so the rate limit won't work as intended. Fix: move all non-trivial bodies to wolfssl_ec_key.c, keep only the struct definition and extern declarations in the header.
